hints.title: All rotten cells start together
hints.body: Every rotten orange begins spreading at minute zero.

hints.title: Track the frontier
hints.body: Process one minute at a time so all newly rotten oranges spread together on the next minute.

hints.title: Count remaining fresh
hints.body: Decrement a fresh-orange counter whenever one becomes rotten. If it remains positive, return `-1`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
queue = all rotten cells
fresh = count of fresh cells
minutes = 0
while queue not empty and fresh > 0:
    process the current queue size:
        for each cell, rot fresh edge-neighbors and enqueue them
    minutes += 1
return minutes if fresh == 0 else -1
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
